newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia jumps on in-line Jan-Sept results.
newsitem.headline: Nokia jumps on in-line Jan-Sept results.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy rose on Thursday in lively trade after the release of its January-September results, brokers said.
At 1215/1015 GMT, Nokia's A series share traded up 12.00 markka at 239.00 markka, after touching 240.00 -- its highest since November 29 last year.
Volume was active at around 125 million markka, accounting for some 81 percent of total Helsinki bourse volume.
Nokia's January-September pre-tax profit fell to 2,228 million markka from 3,984 million in the same period in 1995. The profit was in line with analysts' forecasts.
